aggregate_definition: SHA-256 over the newline-joined '<sha256>  <path>' lines of the inventory below, sorted by POSIX path. Defined over content and names rather than over a container, so it does not depend on tar format, compression or timestamps. This file and collection-completion.json are excluded: they are written after the inventory is computed, so including them would record their previous contents and make the digest unverifiable against the collection it describes.
